src/model.jl:459-462. `overlay!` resolves with `bases = _store_values(model.exec)`, so a partial entry merges onto the current stores (docstring model.jl:418-420). design/spec.md:12859-12861 says "applied through `init!` it overlays the declared defaults, and applied through `overlay!` it overlays the stopped run's stores". design/log.md:2155-2158 (D-063 annotation 2026-10-20) records that the rejected current-stores base returns as `overlay!`'s base (D-429).
judgments.fix: §14.1's overlay base for `init!` is always the declared defaults, never the stopped sim's current stores. Only `overlay!` takes the current stores, and it takes its trace header after the overlay settles. That base exists precisely to keep a condition's meaning independent of history.
